milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because chopping oak trees causes oak_log items to drop and be picked up into the player's inventory. The player starts with only an iron_axe, so any oak_log in inventory confirms successful tree chopping.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted oak_pressure_plate ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_pressure_plate, so its presence confirms successful completion of the full crafting chain (oak_log → oak_planks → oak_pressure_plate).
